defects: The sling is not visible in the production three-quarter, profile, or detail captures despite seven generated canvas meshes.
incumbent_comparison: The typed-array correction generated all seven canvas meshes, but they remain absent in the actual production captures. The visual result is therefore still the same empty frame as v002.
likely_causes: The mesh material still uses back-face culling, and the captured underside/front winding prevents the top-side camera from displaying the surface.
A true opposite camera angle for this wall-side object crosses the room boundary, leaving some views focused on a wall.
next_action_hypothesis: Disable back-face culling on the fabric material and constrain both alternate camera views to interior room angles, then compare the resulting actual production capture.
